blockers: Coffy mobile app and Getir Yemek require app/geolocation state and were not sampled.
Raw automated HTTP requests to Yemeksepeti returned 403; the five public restaurant pages were inspected through the web reader and each was refreshed on 2026-08-11.
The in-app interactive browser was unavailable in this workspace session.
limitations: This is a controlled five-branch snapshot, not an exhaustive nationwide inventory.
Branch stock and seasonal availability can change after the observation date.
Only short factual serving or ingredient descriptions are retained; prices, images, calories, and macros are deliberately absent.
Yemeksepeti is a secondary ordering surface; its use is justified by Coffy's official homepage directing customers there.
